verdict.rationale: Godot has no first-party natural-language interface and no official MCP server. Natural-language operation is only reachable through third-party community MCP projects (Coding-Solo/godot-mcp, hi-godot/godot-ai), which live on GitHub outside Godot's distribution channel. Agents can drive those via the documented headless CLI, the EditorScript/EditorInterface automation APIs and the built-in GDScript LSP, but the evidence does not describe what those community tools actually do. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface, an official MCP/agent integration, documentation or hands-on evidence of NL-driven editor operation, and maintained tooling (the most popular community MCP has been idle since April 2026).
